title: Samsung s10e May patch caused constant reboots while using xdrip+
symptom: After May 24, the phone reboots every 1 to 10 minutes while using xDrip+. Stopping the sensor or deleting xDrip makes it work fine. The issue occurs on Samsung S10e and S10+ devices.
cause: Samsung introduced a significant bug in a system update that conflicts with xDrip's Samsung workarounds, causing constant reboots.
fix: Disable the 'Samsung workarounds' option in xDrip settings (Settings - Less common settings - Other misc options - Samsung Workarounds). Some users also found that a later Samsung update resolved the issue.
evidence_quote: Samsung appear to have introduced quite a significant bug this time... Try this: go in to xDrip settings and disable the `Samsung workarounds`
